title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae selecionam 20 startups brasileiras para incubacao em Lisboa (DN Brasil, 4 September 2026)
what_it_says: DN Brasil reports the call for the 2027 cycle of the Lisbon incubation programme: up to 40 startups to a strategic exploration stage, the 20 best ranked go on, five extra points for six priority sectors, applications to 18 September 2026.
